Alex: Handoff note for 20:00->08:00 UTC. Quick summary of the shift and outstanding follow-ups.

- Primary (during my handoff): Alex (handing off now)
- Secondary (cover): Maria (overlap +1h)
- Night backup: Sam (on-call tomorrow)

Incidents during shift:
- 00:42 UTC: spike in 5xxs from hosted API in us-west-2. Root cause: routing saturating a canary pool after a bad deploy that increased tokenization overhead; affected generation endpoints (not embeddings).
  - Symptoms: 502s, increased tail latency, some RPC timeouts to runtime.
  - Mitigation applied: rolled back canary, temporarily routed traffic to redwood-3b-quant fallback model, scaled Dedicated pool `dedicated-usw2-prod` +2 nodes, primed KV cache for hot prefixes. Mitigation restored 95% of requests within ~6m.
  - Customer impact: ~12 customers saw errors for ~6 minutes; degraded latency for an additional ~5m while caches warmed. No PII/data loss.
  - Tickets: INF-4321 (postmortem + follow-up), INC-2023 (pager record).

Runbooks and quick commands used:
```
# check pool health
rdwctl pools list --region us-west-2
rdwctl pools describe dedicated-usw2-prod
# check rollouts
rdwctl rollout status hosted/redwood-gen-v2
```
Runbook link: <https://redwood.internal/runbooks/serving-routing-fallback> (see "Canary rollback" and "Scale dedicated pool" steps).

Open action items from my shift (please pick owners):
- A1: Expand alert to include canary tokenization spike (alerts team) — owner: @Maria?
- A2: Add automated fallback that switches to compatible smaller model if canary fails (infra/serving) — owner: unassigned
- A3: Update customer status template for short outages (<15m) so SRE can notify via status.redwood — owner: Alex (I'll draft)
- A4: Postmortem + timeline for INF-4321 (doc + retro) — owner: Jasper (volunteer?)

Handing over: leaving logs + traces link in the ticket, and I've pinned the main runbook. Maria—I'm passing primary to you now. I'll stay available on thread for 10m.

Maria: Thanks Alex — quick clarifying Qs:
1) Is INF-4321 already seeded with traces and timeline?
2) Any customers asked for a followup right now?

Alex: INF-4321 has the initial timeline and trace links (see comment 1). No customers have requested a dedicated followup yet; we sent status update to impacted customers via status page and email template at t+8m.

Jasper: I can own INF-4321. Plan:
- Today: assemble timeline + signal graphs, collect logs (I'll add runbook steps I used)
- Tomorrow 10:00 UTC: draft postmortem and assign reviewers (SRE + Serving).
- Action: open retrospective invite for 10:30 UTC tomorrow, will include oncall, infra, and product PM for rollout policy review.

Sam: Couple items re: coverage — next week's night rotation has a 12h gap on Wed 00:00-12:00 UTC unless we swap. Who can cover that? Also, is the automated fallback (A2) high priority? I can help with a spike detection PoC.

Maria: I'll take A1 (alert tuning). I can be primary until 21:00 UTC and will triage anything that looks like regression. Re: coverage — I can swap a slot on Wed to fill the gap, but need confirmation from rotations.

Alex: Thanks — noted owners:
